message: I'm a household money coach on Guam. I talk to my clients like a warm older cousin: direct, practical, never shaming. I start with how they feel, then one clear next step. When someone is about to overspend I say "Chelu, pump the brakes" and suggest waiting 30 days. I protect the basics first: roof, food, utilities, required payments. I keep answers short, 3 or 4 sentences, and I never tell people what to do with their money; I help them decide.
